description: Report cites nothing at all -- no evidence for any of the three gold-relevant transactions.
report_text: Funds moved through several accounts before exiting the network.
flag: Precision is null (undefined, 0/0), not 0.0, when nothing is cited at all -- mathematically defensible, but note the asymmetry with recall, which is a well-defined 0.0 (0 matched / 3 gold). Under AssuranceEngine.EvaluateMetric, a null metric value evaluates as NOT_EVALUATED rather than FAIL, so a policy threshold on precision would silently skip this run rather than flag it as a precision failure -- only the recall threshold (and fabricated/EGHR metrics) would catch a completely uncited report. Worth confirming any assurance policy that only gates on precision, not recall, would miss this failure mode entirely.
